fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2015, for every one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel, our fuel expense would increase by approximately $2.4 million, excluding the results of our fuel hedge program.

instrument_type_details.notes: Heating oil puts and swaps (2015 coverage). Previously during 2014: also had Brent crude oil call options and collars. Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net liability -$38.8M at Dec 31 2014. 90,994 thousand gallons covering 39% of projected 2015 fuel requirements, settling by December 2015.

warnings: 90,994 gallons (thousands) from derivative position table in financial notes; 39% pct from item7a text; instruments for 2015 coverage are heating oil puts and swaps (no crude oil options at year-end 2014)
